detail.longDescription: I built this out of my usage limit frustration in Codex. OpenAI had started announcing more resets (which helped), but I often didn't see them until my usage had already refilled to 100%. I wanted to know ASAP so I could burn through remaining usage before the reset. So I built this text alert service that monitors X and sends text updates when a new Codex reset is announced. It currently sends SMS alerts to users in the US and Canada, and Telegram alerts otherwise. The service has been useful for me - would love any feedback or beta testers on Reset Alerts.
